verdict.rationale: New Relic offers several non-UI automation surfaces. The official New Relic CLI manages entity tags and workloads and records deployment markers, which is a classic CI step. NerdGraph provides a programmatic GraphQL API, and Terraform handles declarative infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can be driven headlessly. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or other CI integration guides), a documented non-interactive auth/API-key flow for CI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
